description:
After the cataclysmic destruction of Nanhuang Continent, young Xu Qing, the sole survivor, accidentally obtains a mysterious purple crystal, thus beginning his cultivation journey.

To survive, he joins the Thunder Squad, experiencing life-or-death battles and forging deep bonds with his teammates. Through trials and tribulations, Xu Qing transforms from a lone wolf into a warrior protecting others, becoming a top expert in the Eight Sects Alliance through his exceptional wisdom and willpower. Facing his nemesis, he resolutely embarks on a journey to uncover the ultimate secrets of the remnants of the divine face in order to protect those around him.

(Source: Youku, translated)
